move_batch_to_device: move a PyTorch tensor batch or dict of tensors to a specified device and detach
flatten_tensor_first_two_dims: flatten the first two dimensions of a PyTorch tensor or dict of tensors into one
slice_tensor_along_dimension: slice a PyTorch tensor or dict of tensors along a given dimension with start and end indices
index_tensor_along_dimension: index a single element from a PyTorch tensor or dict along a given dimension
create_one_hot_encoding: create a one-hot encoded tensor from a 2D label tensor with a specified number of classes
